# SEATTLE OR NASHVILLE AUTOLOGOUS POST-TRANSPLANT VACCINATION

**St. Cloud Guidance:**

RECOMMENDATIONS NOT AVAILABLE
Recommendations for this condition are not available within CDSS. Please refer to facility guidelines or other clinical resources for recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

Select below vaccine order sets based on time from transplant. Only doses that are due will be placed. Follow up vaccine doses in series will need to be ordered, using the below order sets, when they are due. Vaccinations that should be ordered via nursing standing orders are listed as such.

Certain vaccinations are only indicated in those who are a certain age or have other co-morbidities. These indications are noted within parentheses in the below order sets. If the patient does not meet these criteria, cancel the order after selecting the order set.

COVID-19 vaccination changes rapidly. Refer to CDC for most up to date recommendations.

# 3 months

Administer 1st COVID-19 vaccine and influenza vaccine via standing orders

# 4 months

Administer 2nd COVID-19 vaccine via standing orders

# 5 months

Administer 3rd COVID-19 vaccine via standing orders

# 6 months

Tdap - 1 of 3 (Note:subsituted for DTaP-see references below)

Hib - 1 of 3
Hepatitis B - 1 of 2
HPV - 1 of 2 (for those under 45)

Meningococcal conj - 1 of 2 (For those with splenectomy, HIV, or those at risk)

Pneumococcal 20 valent
Polio - 1 of 3
CLICK HERE to order above vaccine orders

# 8 months

Administer 4th COVID-19 vaccine via standing orders
Tdap - 2 of 3 (Note:subsituted for DTaP-see references below)

Hib - 2 of 3
Hepatitis B - 2 of 2
Pneumococcal 23 valent
Polio - 2 of 3
CLICK HERE to order above vaccine orders

# 10 months

Tdap - 3 of 3 (Note:subsituted for DTaP-see references below)

Hib - 3 of 3
Polio - 3 of 3
CLICK HERE to order above vaccine orders

# 12 months

HPV - 2 of 2 (for those under 45)

Meningococcal conj - 2 of 2 (For those with splenectomy, HIV, or those at risk))

Zoster recombinant - 1 of 2
CLICK HERE to order above vaccine orders

# 14 months

Zoster recombinant - 2 of 2

# Annually

Seasonal influenza and COVID-19 per CDC recommendations
References:

- Post-Transplant Vaccinations VA Tennessee Valley Healthcare System (Nashville) Stem Cell Transplant Program Standard Practice Guidelines (01/17/2024)
